title: ATIF-Gemma: Diagnostic Traces for SWE Agents
description: ATIF-Gemma is an open empirical diagnostic corpus containing 64 full-fidelity ATIF v1.7 execution traces of small open-weight coding agents (gemma-4-e4b-it-qat-w4a16-ct) across 16 paired SWE-bench tasks on 4x NVIDIA L4 GPUs. It includes ground-truth reference patches, test patches, prompt token growth logs, tool error counts, and Phase 2 exit code classifications (exit codes -1, 0, 1, 2).
